question: Which of the following Rebellion occurred between 1855-56?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Santhal rebellion**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Santhal Rebellion (1855-56):** 

 
 
• This was a **native rebellion in present-day Bihar and Jharkhand, in eastern India against both the British colonial authority and the corrupt zamindari system by the Santhal people.** 
 
• It started in 1855 and the rebellion was brutally crushed by the **English East India Company by 1856.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kol Rebellion (1831-32):** The Kol Rebellion was a tribal revolt in the Chota Nagpur area in eastern India, now located in present-day Jharkhand and Odisha.
 
• **Ramosi Rebellion (1822-1825): **
 
 
• The Ramosi Peasant Force was an armed force formed by the Ramosi people of the Sahyadri mountain range in India in the late 1820s to revolt against the British East India Company.
 
• The rebellion started around **1822 and ended by 1825**.
 
 
 
• **Paika Rebellion (1817):**
 
 
• **The Paika Rebellion,** also called the Paika Bidroha, was an armed rebellion against **British East India Company rule in Odisha, in eastern India.**
 
• It took place in **1817,** earlier than the timeframe you specified.
 
• **The Paikas** were the **traditional landowning militia of Odisha and served as warriors. **
